newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 366 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 366 contracts.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totalled 366 contracts compared with 731 overnight Monday, according to the CBOT.
There were 38 wheat, 177 corn, 143 soybean, four soymeal and four soyoil contracts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 3/4 to 4-1/2 cent higher, corn was 1/2 to one higher to 1/4 lower, and soybeans were 1/4 lower to one cent per bushel higher.
